title: FC 5903: General Requirements
officialText:
5903.1 Quantities not exceeding the maximum allowable quantity per control area.

The storage, handling and use of flammable solids in amounts not exceeding the maximum allowable quantity per control area as indicated in FC 5003.1* shall be in accordance with FC 5001, 5003, 5901 and this section.

5903.2 Quantities exceeding the maximum allowable quantity per control area.

The storage, handling and use of flammable solids exceeding the maximum allowable quantity per control area as indicated in FC 5003.1* shall be in accordance with FC Chapter 50, this chapter, and NFPA 484.
